reference.label: Suprabasal squamous epithelium
reference.evidence: Largest factor (10% usage) with specific KRT13 (0.71), DSG3, DSC2 (0.92), LY6D (0.93), CALML3, KRT6B (0.95), SERPINB4/5, S100A8/9, PERP, DSP. Basal markers KRT5, KRT14, TP63 and MKI67 have zero weight; terminal markers CRNN/FLG belong to metagene 9.

reference.label: MYC/C12orf75-high nuclear program
reference.evidence: Diffuse (eff. 2383 genes) with one highly specific gene C12orf75 (0.92) plus MYC, NOTCH1, GCLC, SLC16A1, TGIF2 and nucleolar genes (DKC1, FBL, RUVBL1, NOP genes) at moderate specificity. No lineage markers (KRT5, KRT13, TP63, EPCAM, VIM, COL1A1, PTPRC all zero) and no MKI67.

reference.label: Diffuse multi-copy/ZNF gene noise
reference.evidence: Very diffuse (eff. 6018 genes), all weights <0.4%, dominated by paralog/multi-copy families (GOLGA8A/B/K, GOLGA6L4, AGAP5, SPDYE16, many ZNFs, PGA3) and scattered single tissue-inappropriate genes (CALCB, OR6B2, LDHC). Shares IST1/PDE4DIP/SIGLEC15 artifact genes with metagenes 8 and 10.

reference.label: IgG plasma cells
reference.evidence: IGHG1 (36%, spec 1.00), IGHG2, IGHG4 (1.00), IGKC, IGLC7 with plasma-cell program XBP1, MZB1, PRDM1, POU2AF1, TENT5C, DERL3, FCRL5. B-cell marker MS4A1 has zero weight; JCHAIN/IgA are mostly in metagene 27.

reference.label: FDCSP/ODAM-high tumor epithelium
acceptable: Sample- or clone-specific squamous tumor program
reference.evidence: FDCSP (15.6%, spec 1.00) and ODAM (1.00) exclusive, plus FABP4 (0.60), PTHLH, CA12 on a shared squamous background (KRT5, DSP, S100A2, PERP at low specificity). FDC marker CR2 absent and CXCL13 minor; adipocyte (ADIPOQ, PLIN1, CD36) and endothelial (PECAM1) markers absent, so this looks like a tumor-cell subpopulation/clone expressing FDCSP.

reference.label: Stromal fibroblasts
reference.evidence: Specific COL3A1, COL1A1/2, COL5A1/2, COL6A1-3, LUM, PDGFRA, PDGFRB, SFRP1, IGF1 (0.96), DIO2, OGN, PCOLCE, plus HOXA13, PGR, ESR1, NR2F1 indicating cervical/Mullerian stroma. Smooth-muscle DES/MYH11 are in 18 and CAF markers POSTN/COMP in 33.

reference.label: Macrophages
reference.evidence: Exclusive APOE, SPP1, CHIT1, MMP12, MARCO, CCL18 plus CD68, CD163, C1QA/B/C, CTSB/S/L, FCER1G, ITGB2, MSR1, TREM2 (0.84), CD86. S100A8 absent (not neutrophils); DC markers CLEC10A/CD1C sit in metagene 48.

reference.label: Proliferation (histones/G2-M)
reference.evidence: Replication histones H1-5, H3C2, H3C12, H2BC9 (spec ~1.0) with MKI67, TOP2A, BIRC5, CENPF, AURKB, CDK1, SPC24/25, KIF15, FOXM1.

candidates.c7: Mitotic cell cycle and histone genes

reference.label: IST1/ITCH-high noise
reference.evidence: Diffuse (eff. 3036) led by IST1, ITCH (also artifact-like in 10/42) with scattered odd highly specific low-weight genes (PRR36, C20orf144, SYP, COX6B2, MYH7B, SMCO1). KRT7/KRT18/KRT19 are most specific here but at trivial weight (<0.15%); no coherent lineage.

reference.label: Cornified superficial squamous epithelium
reference.evidence: CRNN (10%, spec 0.99), FLG (0.92), CRCT1 (0.90), SPINK7, PRSS3, CNFN, HOPX, SBSN, SCEL, IVL, KLK14, SPRR2E with KRT13/KRT4 background.

reference.label: OR4F17/multi-copy gene artifact
reference.evidence: OR4F17 (12%, spec 0.90) dominates, with multi-copy families USP17L*, PRAMEF*, SPANX*, POTEC, NBPF15 and many tissue-inappropriate single genes (F9, LPA, BPIFA1, TRPC5) at near-1 specificity but tiny weight; also IST1/SIGLEC15 artifact genes.

reference.label: SERPINB13/KRT13 intermediate squamous
reference.evidence: SERPINB13 (3.3%, 0.35), KRT13, DSG3, KLF4, NECTIN4, EHF, GRHL1/3, FOXE1, FAM83C, DUOX1/DUOXA1, FGFR3 - squamous differentiation genes but all with low-moderate specificity (<0.5); diffuse (eff. 1296).

reference.label: ID1/FGFBP1/KRT5-high squamous
reference.evidence: ID1 (4.4%, 0.58) and FGFBP1 (0.59) are the only specific genes, on a broad KRT5, FABP5, KLF5, TNS4, S100A2 squamous background with low specificity. MKI67 and SOX2 absent.

reference.label: KRT15/FGFR3-high squamous epithelium
reference.evidence: KRT15 (5.2%, 0.43), FGFR3 (0.60), MFSD2A (0.82), CYP4X1, PLA2G4F, FAT2, PLCH2, EHF, ITGB4; moderate specificity throughout, consistent with a KRT15+ basal/parabasal squamous state.

reference.label: IFN-gamma response
reference.evidence: CXCL10 (11.7%, 1.00), CXCL11 (0.98), CXCL9, IDO1, GBP1/4/5, WARS1, STAT1, IRF1, TAP1/2, PSMB8/9, APOL genes, CIITA, CD274, BATF2. Type-I ISGs MX1/IFIT1/OAS are concentrated in 34 instead.

reference.label: Diffuse KRT5/DSP squamous
reference.evidence: Squamous genes KRT5, DSP, PERP, KRT15, CALML3 lead but every gene has specificity <0.25 (eff. 1847); a broad background squamous factor without a specific theme.

reference.label: CD4 T cells / Tregs
reference.evidence: TRAC, TRBC1/2, CD3E/D, CD2, CD5, CD28, LCK, ITK with Treg genes CTLA4 (1.00), FOXP3 (0.98), CCR4 (0.97), TIGIT, ICOS, IL2RA. CD8A, CD8B, NKG7, GZMB, GZMK and MS4A1 have zero weight (CD8A is in metagene 53).

reference.label: S-phase/nucleotide synthesis
reference.evidence: RRM2, RRM1, DHFR, GMPS, PRPS2, MTHFD2, MCM4, MYBL2, CDC6, CCNE2, TK1 with TP63 and PTMA; specificities modest (<0.5) and diffuse (eff. 1539).

reference.label: Smooth muscle cells
reference.evidence: DES (1.00), PCP4 (1.00), ACTG2 (0.83), MYH11 (0.62), CNN1 (0.72), PRUNE2, ACTA2, TAGLN, MYLK, LMOD1, SYNPO2, with GREM1, PGR/ESR1/HAND2 stromal genes. Leading weights (SFRP4, CCN2) are shared with fibroblasts; RGS5 (pericyte) is mainly in 22.

reference.label: FABP4/KRT5-high squamous
reference.evidence: FABP4 (4.6%, 0.40) on a squamous background (KRT5, CALML3, DSP, PERP, TMEM45A) with PTPRZ1 (0.36) and IGSF3; overlaps metagene 4 (FABP4) but lacks FDCSP. ADIPOQ, PLIN1, CD36 and PECAM1 absent, so FABP4 likely from tumor cells. Most genes low specificity.

reference.label: Diffuse KRT5/KRT13 squamous
reference.evidence: KRT5, DSP, PERP, KRT13, FABP5, KRT15 lead but all specificities <0.2 (eff. 1818); generic squamous background without a distinctive theme.

reference.label: WWTR1/TEAD/MEIS2-high
reference.evidence: Diffuse; most specific genes MEIS2 (0.63), PROX1 (0.63), SMAD1 (0.60), TEAD2/TEAD4, WWTR1 with CD59, HIPK3, APP, TSC22D1, LAMB1. No lineage markers: PECAM1, VWF, LYVE1, COL1A1, PDGFRA, ACTA2, KRT5, EPCAM, VIM all zero.

reference.label: Endothelial cells
reference.evidence: VWF (0.96), PECAM1, KDR, CDH5, CLDN5, EGFL7, PTPRB, CLEC14A, CALCRL, AQP1, PLVAP, FLT1, ACKR1 and SELP (venular), EPAS1. Lymphatic markers LYVE1 (0.02% weight) and CCL21 essentially absent despite some MMRN1/FLT4.

reference.label: CLCA4/GABRP/PLAC8 squamous
reference.evidence: Low-specificity squamous/mucosal genes S100A8/9, KRT15, DDIT4, PLAT, MUC1/4, CLCA4, TMPRSS11A, with GABRP (0.31), PLAC8 (0.30), CEACAM5/6/7; no gene above 0.31 specificity. Glandular markers MUC5AC, TFF3, PIGR, KRT7 absent.

reference.label: Ribosome biogenesis / RNA processing
reference.evidence: Low-specificity nuclear genes: splicing (SRSF1/2, PRPF8/19, HNRNPU/D), nuclear import (KPNB1, RANBP2, NUP153), nucleolar/ribosome biogenesis (NOP14, NOP56, BRIX1, WDR43, UTP25, DDX21, NOLC1, BMS1). All specificities <0.35.

reference.label: KRT24/SERPINB2-high squamous
reference.evidence: KRT24 (6.4%, 0.80), SERPINB2 (0.63), APOBEC3A (0.54) with shared differentiated-squamous genes KLK10, KRT80, MUC21, TGM1, S100A8/9, A2ML1 at low specificity. CRNN/FLG belong to 9.

reference.label: ERO1A/TMPRSS2-high squamous
reference.evidence: ERO1A (6.8%, 0.66), TMPRSS2 (0.72), PRSS22, SPNS2, MUC22, RNASE7, DUOXA2, HMOX1, HILPDA with low-specificity squamous differentiation genes (S100A8/9, KRT13, MUC21, ECM1). Hypoxia core genes (CA9, NDRG1) are in 32.

reference.label: IgA/IgM plasma cells
reference.evidence: IGHG3, IGHA1, IGHA2 (1.00), IGHM (0.84), IGHD, JCHAIN (0.86), with XBP1, MZB1, PRDM1, TNFRSF17, DERL3, TXNDC5.

reference.label: SAT1-dominated
reference.evidence: SAT1 alone carries 35% of the weight (spec 0.86); other genes (TNFSF10, TP53INP2 0.60, SPINT1, TSPAN6) have low specificity and form no clear theme.

reference.label: Nuclear/splicing transcripts (DDX39B)
reference.evidence: Diffuse (eff. 1610) low-specificity nuclear/splicing genes DDX39B, CCNL2, SNRNP70, ARGLU1, LUC7L3, PNISR, LENG8 plus artifact-associated SIGLEC15/OR4F17; only scattered specific low-weight genes (DUT, RTEL1).

reference.label: Invasive/partial-EMT basal tumor cells
reference.evidence: LAMC2 (0.78), LAMB3, LAMA3, COL17A1 (0.69), COL7A1, ITGA6, ITGB4, ITGB6 with TNC, PLAU, THBS1, SERPINE1, INHBA, MMP13, FST. COL1A1 and VIM ~absent, so this is epithelial pEMT/invasive-edge rather than stroma.

reference.label: Basal squamous cells (TP63/CYP24A1)
reference.evidence: TP63 (most specific here, 0.53), CYP24A1 (0.83), ITGA3, ITGB4, COL17A1, LAMB3, COL7A1, RNF152, NGFR, TNFRSF21. KRT5 weight small here (KRT5 is spread across 4/12/15/20) and MKI67 absent.

reference.label: Hypoxia
reference.evidence: SLC2A1 (0.59), NDRG1 (0.70), SLC6A8, DDIT4, VEGFA, ADM, ANKRD37, CA9, EGLN3, PGK1, PFKP, HK2, PFKFB3, LDHA, NDUFA4L2, BNIP3L, STC2.

reference.label: Cancer-associated fibroblasts (POSTN+)
reference.evidence: POSTN (0.95), SULF1 (0.97), COMP (1.00), COL10A1, COL8A1, SFRP2, HTRA3, NTM, ADAM12, INHBA, CTHRC1, THBS2, FAP, FN1 on a collagen background. DES and MYH11 absent, ACTA2 low.

reference.label: Type I interferon response
reference.evidence: MX1 (0.61), MX2, IFIT1 (0.99), IFIT3/5, RSAD2, CMPK2, OAS1-3, OASL, IFI44/IFI44L, ISG15, HERC5/6, USP18, XAF1, EPSTI1. CXCL10/IDO1/GBP1 are concentrated in 14.

reference.label: MAL/KRT78 differentiated squamous
reference.evidence: MAL (0.87), KRT78, LIPH, LMO7, PSCA, LYPD2, ANXA9, ADGRF1, EPS8L1 with low-specificity KRT13, EMP1, PPL, MUC21/22, MUC4, ECM1. T-cell context absent (CD3E zero), so MAL here reflects squamous differentiation.

reference.label: Cell cycle (weak, mixed)
reference.evidence: Mixed S and G2/M genes at low-moderate specificity: TPX2, MKI67, RRM2, NUSAP1, CEP55, E2F8 (0.40), STIL (0.41), UBE2T, CDCA5, ESCO2, with tumor-cell background (TNS4, RBP1, JUN).

reference.label: WSB1/GABBR1/DPY19L2-high
reference.evidence: Diffuse (eff. 2562) with moderately specific WSB1, DPY19L2, GABBR1, ADAMTS10, PLEKHH2, SNED1, NFATC4, BOC, LCAT plus artifact genes IST1/PDE4DIP/SIGLEC15. Some stromal hints (DCN 0.49 at tiny weight) but COL1A1, COL3A1, LUM, PDGFRA have zero weight.

reference.label: Stress response (PMAIP1/ATF3)
reference.evidence: PMAIP1 (0.69), ATF3, DDIT3, PPP1R15A, CEBPG, MDM2, BTG3, IER5, NR1D1, DHRS2, with NF-kB genes (NFKB2, REL, NFKBIZ, CXCL8, CCL20).

reference.label: Endocervical glandular epithelium, inflamed
reference.evidence: Mucinous/glandular genes MUC5AC, TFF3, SCGB2A2, MUC5B, DMBT1 (all ~1.00), PIGR, LTF, TFF1, AGR2, SPDEF, KRT19, with inflammatory CXCL2/3/5, PTGS2 (1.00), CSF3, IL6, LIF. Neutrophil markers CSF3R, FCGR3B, S100A8 and squamous KRT5/KRT13 absent.

reference.label: PTMA-high
reference.evidence: PTMA alone carries 12.6% (spec 0.59); remaining genes are housekeeping/nuclear (RAN, HMGB1, DEK, HNRNPUL1, SRSF3/4) with specificity <0.25.

reference.label: DNA replication (S phase)
reference.evidence: MCM2-7, TYMS, E2F1, UNG, PCNA, HELLS, UHRF1, CDCA7, ZNF367, TIMELESS, LIG1, GINS1/2, POLA1, CHAF1A at moderate specificity (0.3-0.56).

reference.label: ITCH/TRPC4AP-high
reference.evidence: Diffuse low-specificity genes led by ITCH and TRPC4AP (0.42), HM13, NCOA6, PDXK, CTNND1; no gene above 0.42 specificity and no coherent theme; shares artifact-like ITCH with 8.

reference.label: PI3/KRT4 superficial squamous
reference.evidence: PI3 (2.6%, 0.89), KLK13, KLK12, KRT4 (0.36), HPGD, GJB6, CALML5, KRTDAP, CYP4F22, ATP13A4, POF1B with shared differentiation genes A2ML1, MUC21, KRT24, IVL, TGM1.

reference.label: NF-kB-like signaling (CFLAR/REL)
reference.evidence: Low-specificity signaling genes EHBP1L1, CFLAR, REL, NFKB1, BCL3, NFKBIE, MCL1, TYK2, STAT6, IFNGR1, PSTPIP2, PTPRE; no gene above 0.51 specificity and no lineage markers.

reference.label: Mitosis (G2/M)
reference.evidence: PLK1 (0.71), CDC20 (0.81), CCNB1/2, HMMR, TROAP, ASPM, KIF14/20A/20B, CENPE/F, TOP2A, MKI67, BIRC5, AURKA, BUB1, DLGAP5.

reference.label: FOSL2/JUN/YAP1 diffuse
reference.evidence: Diffuse (eff. 1919) with uniformly low specificity (<0.3): FOSL2, JUN, NOTCH2, YAP1, LRP1, KIDINS220, AHNAK, IGF2R; no coherent cell-type or program signal.

reference.label: DNA replication (S phase)
reference.evidence: E2F1 (0.59), TYMS, MCM2-7, UHRF1, WDR76, POLA1, PCNA, CDC6, CDC45, CCNE1/2, GINS2, CHAF1A/B, MCM10, E2F2 at moderate specificity; parallels metagene 41.

reference.label: Dendritic cells (cDC2/Langerhans)
reference.evidence: FCER1A (1.00), PKIB (1.00), LGALS2, CLEC10A (0.84), CD1C, HLA-DQB2, HLA-DR/DP, with Langerhans genes CD207 (0.95), CD1A (0.93), CD1E, S100B; some monocyte genes (FCN1, MNDA). Macrophage APOE/C1Q in 6; KIT (mast) in 85.

reference.label: Inflammatory CCL19+ fibroblasts
reference.evidence: CXCL9 (5.9%, 0.61), CCL19 (0.85), C7 (0.59), C3, CXCL12, VCAM1, TNFSF13B, TMEM119, MSC, RBP5, CCL13, FGF7, DPT, SERPING1. Core collagens/PDGFRA have zero weight here (captured in 5) and PTPRC, CD3E, LAMP3, CR2 are absent.

reference.label: Epithelial tumor cells (PERP/SGK1/PLAT)
reference.evidence: Diffuse factor (eff. 1603 genes) of epithelial genes PERP, MAL2, TNS4, KLF5, EHF, CLDN7, SERPINB4, TMPRSS11D, MUC4, FOXA1 (0.25), PLPP2 (0.29), all low specificity; keratins KRT5/KRT13/KRT7/KRT8/KRT19, TP63 and MUC5B have zero weight, so no specific squamous or glandular subtype can be claimed.

reference.label: SH3BGRL/TMEM230/EID1-high
reference.evidence: Broad housekeeping genes (SH3BGRL, TMEM230 0.40, EID1, MBNL1, TUBB, GNAS, CD44) with low specificities and no lineage markers; shares many genes with 55/65, suggesting generic expression-level variation.

reference.label: Mature dendritic cells (mregDC, CCL22)
reference.evidence: Dominated by MARCKS (48% weight, spec 0.69), but the specific genes are a mature/regulatory DC program: CCL22 (0.99), EBI3 (0.67), CD83, LAMP3, FSCN1, CCR7, CCL17, IL12B, LY75, CD40, BIRC3. HLA-DRA, CD1C, CLEC9A, CCL19 and IDO1 have zero weight, so confidence is tempered.

reference.label: CD8 cytotoxic T cells (GZMK+)
reference.evidence: CD8A (0.91), CD8B, GZMK (0.89), GZMA (0.98), CRTAM (0.90), GZMH, CST7, EOMES, NKG7, PRF1, THEMIS plus CD3E/CD3D/TRAC/CD2; CD4, FOXP3 absent and NK markers KLRF1/NCAM1/FCGR3A absent; exhaustion markers (HAVCR2, PDCD1, CXCL13) weak or absent.

reference.label: IL1R2/CYP1B1/VWA2-high
reference.evidence: Diffuse (eff. 2036) with few specific genes: IL1R2 (0.87), CYP1B1 (0.54), VWA2 (0.44), PRRG3, EMID1, GAD1, SCD5, GAS1, COL4A5, plus IFNGR1/TSC22D1/ALDH2 at low specificity. No lineage markers (DCN, COL1A1, PDGFRA/B, ACTA2, KRT5, EPCAM, PECAM1, VIM all zero); possibly a tumor/sample-specific state.

reference.label: B2M/MHC-I-high housekeeping
reference.evidence: B2M (9%, spec 0.31), PTMA, HLA-B, PSMB8, TAP1, HLA-E with mostly low-specificity housekeeping genes; STAT1, IRF1, HLA-A/C and class II genes absent, so not a convincing IFN program.

reference.label: Nuclear/long-gene transcripts (DDX3X/ANKHD1)
reference.evidence: Diffuse (eff. 1813) set of chromatin/RNA-processing and long genes (DDX3X, ANKHD1, RBM33, USP25, PUM1, KMT2E, ASH1L, SETD2, SON) with specificities below 0.3 and no lineage markers; may reflect nuclear-enriched transcript capture.

reference.label: ANXA2/S100A10/MYH9 cytoskeletal housekeeping
reference.evidence: B2M, ANXA2, S100A10, MYH9, S100A11, S100A6, glycolytic (PKM, TPI1, GPI, ENO1) and proteasome genes, all with specificity below 0.25; no lineage-specific genes.

reference.label: TNF/NF-kB inflammatory response (TNFAIP2)
reference.evidence: TNFAIP2 (21%, spec 0.96) with NF-kB targets ICAM1, SOD2, CFB, NFKBIA, NFKBIZ, NFKB2, RELB, ZC3H12A, IRAK2, TNFAIP3, BIRC3 and acute-phase SAA1/2/4; lineage markers (KRT5, EPCAM, COL1A1, PTPRC, CD68, PECAM1) have zero weight, consistent with a shared program.

reference.label: Multi-copy/paralog genes (SMG1/ZNG1A)
reference.evidence: Top genes SMG1 (pseudogene-rich), ZNG1A, OR4F17, CCNL2, SIGLEC15 plus many unrelated genes with moderate specificity (RHOT2, ANKS3, TPM4, KCTD13); shares SMG1/ZNG1A/OR4F17 with 80. No coherent biology; likely probe/mapping artifact.

reference.label: USP48/ASH1L/ZNHIT6-high
reference.evidence: Unrelated nuclear/housekeeping genes with unusually high specificity (ASH1L 0.78, ZNHIT6 0.76, COP1 0.71, YARS2 0.71, UBR3, PPP6R1, USP48) and no biological theme; consistent with a probe-level or sample-specific artifact.

reference.label: B cells
reference.evidence: MS4A1 (1.00), BANK1 (0.99), BLK (0.97), FCRL1 (0.97), CD22 (0.90), CR2 (0.90), CD19 (0.83), PAX5, CD79A, TNFRSF13C, POU2AF1. Plasma markers JCHAIN, XBP1, SDC1, MZB1 absent; MKI67, BCL6, FDCSP absent.

reference.label: ER stress / unfolded protein response
reference.evidence: Diffuse factor with ER-stress/ERAD genes HSP90B1, HYOU1, SELENOS, EDEM1, EIF2AK3 (PERK), DNAJB9, SYVN1, DERL1, CRELD2, SEL1L plus BTG2, BCL2L11, BMF; but HSPA5, XBP1 and DDIT3 are absent and specificities are below 0.35.

reference.label: Inflammatory fibroblasts (SFRP4/THBS1/C3)
reference.evidence: SFRP4 (0.50), THBS1, MMP2, LUM, PDGFRA (0.42), C3, C1R/C1S, NNMT, FGF7, GREM1, CTSK, PDPN, FAP, MMP3 (0.74), CCL2, CXCL6, IL6, PTGIS. Smooth muscle/pericyte markers ACTA2, MYH11, RGS5, PDGFRB absent.

reference.label: GGNBP2/MLH3/METTL17-high
reference.evidence: Many unrelated nuclear/mitochondrial housekeeping genes with very high specificity (MLH3 1.00, IP6K2 0.90, METTL17 0.88, TAMM41 0.89, COQ8B 0.90, GGNBP2 0.79) and no biological theme; consistent with a probe-level or sample-specific artifact.

reference.label: TRIP12/MBNL1/KHDRBS1 housekeeping
reference.evidence: MYH9, TRIP12, PTMA, MBNL1, KHDRBS1, HNRNPF and other housekeeping genes with low specificity (max SACM1L 0.59); overlaps 51/55; no lineage markers.

reference.label: Immediate early / stress response (CEBPD/FOS)
reference.evidence: CEBPD (11.9%, 0.73), FOS (0.76), JUNB (0.71), NR4A1, NR4A2, CSRNP1, SOCS3, ERRFI1, KLF10, BTG2, CEBPB, MAFF, EGR3, ZFP36, DUSP1, KDM6B; heat-shock genes (HSPA1A/B) belong to 81 instead.

reference.label: LGALS3/FBXO32/SQSTM1-high
reference.evidence: Low-specificity genes LGALS3, TMBIM1, FTH1, LDAF1, SQSTM1, FBXO32 (0.43), MTUS1 (0.40), PPP1R15A, NDRG2, DUSP10; hints of stress/autophagy but no coherent lineage or strong program.

reference.label: NK/T lymphocyte genes (KLRG1/STAT4)
reference.evidence: Diffuse lymphocyte genes (PIK3R1, CXCR4, PTPRC, IKZF1, ITGA4, EVL) with specific KLRG1 (0.98), GNLY (0.87), SCML4 (0.90), STAT4, KLRK1, KLRD1, NELL2, PTGDR, TXK; CD3E/CD3D, NKG7, GZMB and NCAM1 have zero weight, so T vs NK identity is unclear.

reference.label: Plasmacytoid dendritic cells
reference.evidence: IRF8 (0.91), LILRA4 (1.00), CLEC4C (1.00), GZMB (1.00), TCL1A (1.00), IL3RA, TLR7, SMPD3, SCT, PACSIN1, IRF4, IRF7, TCF4. B cell markers MS4A1/CD19 and plasma JCHAIN absent; cDC1 markers XCR1/CLEC9A absent.

reference.label: Inflamed squamous epithelium (IL1A/IL36G)
reference.evidence: Specific IL1A (0.54), IL36G (0.55), IL36RN (0.53), HEPHL1, RNASE7, CLCA4, ALDH1A3, ERO1A, IL1RN with squamous differentiation genes at low specificity (IVL, PPL, KRT13, SPRR2A/F, TMPRSS11D/E, CSTB); KRT5/TP63 absent and ISGs only weak (RSAD2, OAS1).

reference.label: NPM1/PKM/FLNA housekeeping
reference.evidence: NPM1, PKM, SCPEP1, MED14, FLNA, CLSTN1 (0.47), TXNDC17 with low specificity and no coherent lineage or program.

reference.label: PLSCR1/DDIT4-high (weak IFN)
reference.evidence: PLSCR1 (6.4%, 0.48) and DDIT4 with weak ISGs (MX1 0.05, OAS2, OAS3, IFI27, DTX3L) and housekeeping genes; the bona fide IFN program (IFIT1, MX1, ISG15) is concentrated in metagene 34, so this is not a clear IFN factor.

reference.label: Glandular/mucinous epithelium (MUC16/GDF15)
reference.evidence: Specific GDF15 (0.73), MUC16 (0.60), GCNT3, TMC5, SLC6A14, RDH10, LYPD2, CEACAM7/5, MUC20, WFDC2, XDH with MUC1, MUC4, LCN2; squamous KRT5/TP63 absent, MUC5B/MUC5AC/PAX8 absent, so a specific endocervical identity cannot be claimed.

reference.label: TIA1/CHD6/RBM39-high
reference.evidence: Unrelated housekeeping/RNA-binding genes with near-exclusive specificity (TIA1 0.99, CHD6 0.99, TOGARAM1 0.95, RBM39 0.85, HECTD4 0.84, TTLL1 0.83) and no biological theme; consistent with a probe-level or sample-specific artifact.

reference.label: ZNF664/SMAD2/SZRD1 housekeeping
reference.evidence: Housekeeping genes (ZNF664, MBD2, SMAD2, EIF4G2, MORC3, SZRD1, CEBPZ, STAG2) with moderate-to-low specificity (max 0.54) and no lineage genes; closely overlaps metagene 94.

reference.label: TMSB4X-dominated
reference.evidence: TMSB4X carries 16% of weight (spec 0.62; TMSB4Y also 0.70) with otherwise low-specificity housekeeping genes (CMPK1, DAP, ARF1, TPT1); no lineage markers.

reference.label: RBM5/SETD5/GATAD1-high
reference.evidence: Unrelated genes with near-exclusive specificity (GATAD1 1.00, ZNF407 0.99, TMEM234 0.97, BRAF 0.96, ELMOD3 0.96, ETNK1 0.95, DUSP11 0.93, RBM5 0.90) and no shared biology; consistent with a probe-level or sample-specific artifact.

reference.label: NPM1/ZFP36L2/STT3B housekeeping
reference.evidence: NPM1, ZFP36L2, STT3B, MAPKAPK2, NAP1L1 (0.45), PHF21A (0.46) with otherwise low-specificity genes; no coherent theme.

reference.label: ER chaperones / secretory pathway
reference.evidence: P4HB, HSPA5 (0.36), CALR, MANF, PDIA4, PDIA6, DNAJB11, HYOU1, SEC61A1, RPN1, SDF2L1, TMED2/9, COPA/COPG1; JCHAIN/MZB1 and COL1A1 absent so not plasma cells or collagen-secreting fibroblasts; specificities modest.

reference.label: ZNG1A/SMG1 multi-copy genes
reference.evidence: ZNG1A (3.9%, 0.51) and SMG1 plus OR4F17 and many unrelated low-weight genes, overlapping metagene 59; no coherent biology.

reference.label: Heat shock / stress response
reference.evidence: HSPA1B (0.93), HSPA1A (0.95), DNAJB1, HSPH1, BAG3, DNAJA4, HSPD1, ZFAND2A with EGR1 (16%, 0.96), JUN, IER2/3/5; FOS and CEBPD lie mainly in metagene 66.

reference.label: NPM1/HNRNPF/CDV3 housekeeping
reference.evidence: NPM1, HNRNPF, CDV3, EIF3A, CDC73 (0.50) and RNA-processing/housekeeping genes with low specificity; no lineage markers.

reference.label: RAB7A/KLF4/RNF11 housekeeping
reference.evidence: RAB7A, RNF11, ACTG1, KLF4, KLF3, ARL8B, TIPARP with specificities at or below 0.31; no coherent lineage or program.

reference.label: Pericytes / vascular smooth muscle
reference.evidence: NOTCH3, HEYL (0.85), EGFLAM (0.78), ABCC9, KCNJ8, RGS5, PDGFRB, MCAM, PI15, CDH6, FHL5, ITGA7, TBX2, MYH11, ACTA2, TAGLN, COL4A1/2. Endothelial PECAM1/VWF/CDH5 and fibroblast DCN/LUM absent; DES absent.

reference.label: Mast cells
reference.evidence: Highly specific KIT (1.00), CPA3 (1.00), IL1RL1 (1.00), CTSG (1.00), MS4A2, HPGDS, HDC, CMA1, ADCYAP1, VWA5A, GATA2, TPSAB1 (0.49), though top-weight genes (TSC22D3, DDX6, NDST2) are less specific; CLC low.

reference.label: KDM5A/ZNF580/ENTPD4-high
reference.evidence: Diffuse (eff. 1742) RNA-processing/nuclear genes (KDM5A, SRSF2, ZNF580, ENTPD4 0.66, CIRBP, SAFB2, SF3B1, CBX7) with low specificity; no lineage markers.

reference.label: MX1/DDIT4/PLSCR1 diffuse (weak IFN)
reference.evidence: Diffuse (eff. 1480) with MX1 (0.16), DDIT4, PLSCR1, OAS1/2/3, IFI27 and housekeeping genes all below 0.2 specificity; the main IFN program is metagene 34.

reference.label: PIK3R1/SESN3/SPRY2-high
reference.evidence: Low-specificity genes PIK3R1 (0.46), ITPRIPL2, SESN3, LAPTM4B, NFIB, CAV2, SPRY2 (0.60), HMGN5, TEAD2; no lineage markers and no clear program.

reference.label: NFE2L2/HSPB1/MBD2-high
reference.evidence: NFE2L2 (4.2%, 0.39), MBD2, HSPB1, RNF7, STT3B with housekeeping genes; classic NRF2 targets beyond SOD1/GSR are weak, so no clear program.

reference.label: Neutrophil-like myeloid cells
reference.evidence: Neutrophil-associated genes NAMPT, PFKFB3 (0.52), ACSL1, CSF3R (0.48), NAIP (0.82), MKNK1, IRAK3, MEFV, CLEC7A, SIRPB2, FCGR3B, MMP25, BEST1; but S100A8/S100A9, CXCL8, FPR1 and CD14/LYZ are absent and CXCR2 weak, so identity is uncertain.

reference.label: Macrophages
reference.evidence: C1QA/B/C, CD14 (0.53), CSF1R (0.54), CD163, F13A1 (0.70), STAB1 (0.82), CD163L1 (0.99), GPR34, SLCO2B1, MS4A6A, MAFB, MRC1, FOLR2, SELENOP; S100A8/9 and SPP1/APOE/TREM2 absent.

reference.label: SRP9/DAZAP2/UFC1 housekeeping
reference.evidence: SRP9, DAZAP2, LSP1, UFC1, UXT and other housekeeping genes (max spec 0.45); overlaps 95 and 98, no lineage markers.

reference.label: Hormone-responsive stromal fibroblasts (IGFBP5/PI16)
reference.evidence: IGFBP5 (0.52), CRISPLD2, RASD1, CCN5, DKK1, PI16 (0.85), TNXB, ADAM33, TBX3, HAND2, MEDAG, TWIST2, with PGR, ESR1, GREB1; plus CDH19/SCN7A (0.9) hinting at a minor nerve-associated contribution. DCN/LUM/COL1A1 and ACTA2/DES absent; SOX10/MPZ weak.

reference.label: EIF4G2/SZRD1/MORC3 housekeeping
reference.evidence: EIF4G2, SZRD1, ARF6, IFI16, MORC3, ADAR, CEBPZ, STAT1 (0.03) with low specificity; overlaps 75; no lineage markers.

reference.label: DAZAP2/STAT1/HLA-B housekeeping
reference.evidence: DAZAP2 (0.40), STAT1, HLA-B, TOP1, USP9X, GBP2, HLA-E with low specificity; overlaps 92/98; ISGs weak, no lineage markers.

reference.label: Glycolysis/metabolic housekeeping (RAN/PKM)
reference.evidence: RAN, GNAS, HNRNPF, PLP2, FAM162A, PKM, TPI1, PGK1, GPI, GAPDH, OXPHOS and proteasome genes, all with specificity at or below 0.3; MKI67/cell-cycle genes not featured.

reference.label: SOS1/UBE2D3/KIF5B housekeeping
reference.evidence: UBE2D3, SOS1, KIF5B, EIF3A, POLR2K, ATE1 and other housekeeping genes (max spec 0.38); overlaps 99; no lineage markers.

reference.label: SRP9/DAZAP2/IFNGR1 housekeeping
reference.evidence: SRP9, DAZAP2, IFNGR1, TFRC, UFC1, SOS2 with low specificity (max 0.41); overlaps 92/95; no coherent theme.

reference.label: GNAS/KIF5B/SOS1 housekeeping
reference.evidence: GNAS, KIF5B, UBE2D3, DYNLT3, EIF3A, SOS1 and other housekeeping genes (max spec 0.46); overlaps 97; no lineage markers.
